_comment: Real public sources this project's corpus is built from. scripts/fetch_corpus.py downloads exactly these URLs into data/raw/ (gitignored) and verifies each file's sha256 against this manifest before scripts/ingest.py chunks it. The CXL and PCIe specification PDFs are copyrighted by the CXL Consortium / PCI-SIG (the CXL 1.1 PDF is explicitly an Evaluation Copy); this repo therefore never commits their extracted text, only this manifest, the fetch/ingest scripts, and the measured page counts in docs/.
